verdict.rationale: Square exposes webhooks for event-driven triggers and an official MCP server for AI-agent integration, which are building blocks for automation, but there's no evidence of a native, no-code 'autonomous background automation' engine akin to workflow/rules builders — developers would need to build such automation themselves on top of the API/webhooks/MCP primitives. Missing for 10: a documented autonomous automation/workflow feature, scheduled/triggered agent tasks, or first-party examples of AI automations running unattended.
